# The Complete Electrode
# Expert & Partner

### We are specialists in medical electrode design, development and manufacturing, recognised for
### our engineering expertise, quality and regulatory excellence. 

[ Let's Talk ][20]

## For more than 20 years, Intelesens have been manufacturing and developing electrodes for the
## medical device industry. 

For over 20 years, Intelesens has developed and manufactured electrodes for the medical device
industry. Founded in Belfast by the technologist behind the first out-of-hospital defibrillator,
we’ve become a trusted provider for both global corporations and boutique companies.

We specialise in design, development and manufacture of medical electrodes and biosensor interfaces
for medical device companies worldwide. Our expertise spans custom electrode technologies,
physiological monitoring and OEM product development.

## Manufactured to the highest quality standards

We are proud of our strong technical and production expertise built around our customer’s exacting
needs and requirements. Based on our customer requirements, we can develop and manufacture a range
of electrode types.

## A service dedicated to your requirements

Our in-house team will work with you to develop a product to meet your requirements including:

Design Low-Cost Manufacture Validation Manufacturing Customisation Prototyping Regulatory Compliance

### Dedicated to the design, development and manufacture of medical electrodes, we understand every
### customers product requirements are unique.

Whether you’re a start-up or multinational, our flexible partnership approach and in-house expertise
deliver cost-effective, customised solutions from concept to full scale production.

## Let’s Talk!

Contact us to discuss your product design, manufacturing and regulatory requirements.

## Why Choose Us?

#### 1-Stop solution

We provide a full solution for Telemedicine remote monitoring consisting of high quality, user
friendly ECG monitors, our proven ECG software “HRS” and all component required to make up a
complete working solution.

#### 12-lead ECG monitors

Our ECG monitors for patients are the most easy to use in the industry. The user friendly design and
the voice-assistance of the HeartView P12/8 Mobile create an exceptionally easy to use device
allowing anybody to record a hospital-grade ECG.

#### Flexibility and support

We take great pride in our ability to assist our customers to create solution that fits their needs.
Rely on our team to provide assistance for creating the solution from planning through integration
and to operation.

Africa (Pty) Ltd has provided integrated software solutions to healthcare organisations throughout Africa and the Middle East. With our local knowledge and experience, we strive to be the preferred business partner in delivering effective long-term solutions and services. ## MEDITECH Expanse ### Expanse: The Intelligent EHR MEDITECH's [Expanse EHR][105] is designed to adapt and grow along with our customers' needs. Expanse's web-based platform is fully interoperable for more connected care, and leverages cloud technology and AI to keep you at the forefront of innovation. ### Intelligent Interoperability MEDITECH is advancing the charge toward [intelligent interoperability][106] by enabling clinicians to search vast amounts of data inside and outside the EHR quickly and assemble the data in meaningful ways for better decision making. ### Give patients easy and flexible access to care Patients expect [intuitive, frictionless access to their care][107], both virtually and in person. With MEDITECH Expanse, you can give them convenient ways to stay engaged and up to date across the care continuum — even between episodes of care. ## Stay connected with the latest news and stories * About * [Vision][108] * [Executives][109] * [MEDITECH International][110] * [Community][111] * [PAIA/POPIA][112] * [Awards][113] * [News][114] * [Events][115] * [International Blog][116] * [Careers][117] * [Contact][118] [MEDITECH South Africa Customer Service][119] ### [Building Africa’s Data Future: MEDITECH at DataFest Africa 2026][120] August 12, 2026 — On August 6th, the Aga Khan University in Nairobi hosted DataFest Africa 2026. Framed as a community baraza under the theme Kujenga Na Data | Building with Data, the gathering brought together researchers, technology innovators, policymakers, and industry experts to address critical questions surrounding ethical innovation, local context, and community-centered data systems. ### [Turning clinical risk into financial resilience: deriving value with MEDITECH's Excellence ### Toolkits][121] July 1, 2026 — In modern healthcare, clinical outcomes and financial sustainability are inextricably linked. Unmanaged patient readmissions and preventable complications create severe financial friction, draining resources that could otherwise be allocated to patient care. Learn how healthcare organisatons can bridge this gap by leveraging the MEDITECH EHR Excellence Toolkit Library. ### [A Global Celebration of Excellence: MEDITECH Leadership Joins Princess Zahra Aga Khan at AKU ### Convocation 2026][122] March 24, 2026 — Earlier this year, Aga Khan University hosted its prestigious 2026 Convocation, marked by the presence of distinguished international leaders, including Princess Zahra Aga Khan, and a high-level delegation from MEDITECH. ### Sign Up for MEDITECH Email Updates Find out about our events, webinars, blog posts, and more when you sign up for our mailing list! The last frontier. And the most impactful.
The last frontier. And the most impactful.
The last frontier. And the most impactful.
The software industry has failed the most important sectors of civilisation

Healthcare systems run on legacy software. Life sciences still run clinical trials through email and
legacy tools. Government agencies manage crises with PDFs.

General-purpose AI cannot operate inside regulated environments without a regulated home

If an AI model can’t be audited, approved, and deployed in healthcare or government, that’s not a
missing feature. It’s years of regulatory engineering.

Building the critical infrastructure for AI in the world's largest industry

Total market size by 2030

## ~$20 Trillion

Healthcare will soon be a $20 trillion market.

Potential for displacement

## ~$10 Trillion

Within healthcare, there is potential to displace $10 trillion of spending with AI-driven, agentic
technology.

# One platform.
# Deployed globally.

Infrastructure for Care Delivery & Research at scale

The Huma Operating System is the foundation for AI in regulated industries. It creates a governed
model of reality by unifying clinical, operational, research, and enterprise data into a single
trusted platform.

Built on this foundation, organisations can rapidly design, build, and deploy mission-critical
software, AI agents, intelligent workflows, and digital services. From ambient AI, clinical decision
support, patient engagement, and virtual care to clinical trials, population health, operational
command centres, national health platforms, and life sciences applications, every solution is
powered by the same secure, compliant, and reusable operating system. By embedding governance,
security, interoperability, and regulatory controls into the platform itself, the Huma Operating
System enables organisations to move from idea to deployment in weeks rather than years, delivering
AI that can be trusted, audited, and scaled across healthcare and other regulated industries.

Regulatory coverage that compounds

One cleared platform, certified and registered worldwide. The Huma Cloud Platform is already
regulated: a library of clinical applications ready to deploy. Our Forward Deployment Engineers
build the remaining capabilities for each customer, while our regulatory engine transforms those
innovations into FDA Class II and EU MDR-regulated products in weeks rather than years.

## We make enterprise-wide intelligence buildable inside regulated environments.

## 100+

Applications built and configured on HCP

## 100+

Global clients across pharma, providers, and governments

## ~100M

Patients supported globally with HCP products

welcome to plessey

# Engineering
# the future in light

[ Our technology
][14]
[ Contact
][15]

### Technologies shaped by light.
### We design and build two photonic technologies – integrated under one roof, engineered to work
### together.

microleds

### Smaller, brighter, sharper, more efficient.

The visual interface for AR, MR and next-era wearables. Our MicroLED technology delivers
unprecedented pixel density and energy efficiency. Designed for people, ready to scale.

optical interconnects

### Replacing electrical signals with light

Higher data rates. Lower latency. Far less energy. Built for the growing demands of AI
infrastructure, optical interconnects move data between chips, cards and racks more efficiently than
conventional electrical connections.

Together, these technologies form the hardware foundation for AI and next-era computing.

[ Explore our technology
][16]

## Total process.
## One operation.

Only Plessey combines research, IP, materials, processes and manufacturing in one integrated
operation. By controlling every step – from source to signal – we shorten development cycles and
strengthen every stage.

##### Deep know-how

70+ years of innovation. We’ve built our expertise through decades of research, development and
manufacturing in photonics and semiconductor technologies.

##### Broad capability

Research to volume production. Our integrated facility enables rapid iteration from laboratory
breakthrough to scaled manufacturing – without handoffs, delays or compromised specifications.

##### Single facility

Plymouth, UK – every stage connected. When research, process engineering and production occupy the
same building, problems get solved faster and products reach market sooner.

[ About Plessey
][17]

### Independent spirit. Serious intent.

###### We don’t follow familiar paths—we set new ones. Tested, proven, scaled.

When the world’s largest technology companies need breakthroughs in optical technologies, they come
to us. Not noise, not hype – just capability, trusted and relied on.

Seventy years of invention – still moving forward.

Our solutions

## How can we help you?

### Operating room

In the operating room, where precision and reliability are paramount, our solutions bring effortless
improvements in care. Our solutions are designed to support surgical teams, with warming devices and
bronchoscopes that ensure patient stability and enhance procedural safety, helping you achieve the
best outcomes in every surgery.

[ Read more ][38]
[ Read more ][39]

### Intensive care unit

Our integrated solutions include advanced temperature management systems, precise fluid and blood
warming devices, and single-use bronchoscopes, all designed to enhance patient care. These solutions
support ICU teams in delivering optimal treatment, improving outcomes, and supporting patient safety
in critical moments.

[ Read more ][40]
[ Read more ][41]

### Emergency department

In the emergency room, rapid and accurate care is crucial. Patient warming technology ensures that
interventions are delivered at optimal temperatures, preventing hypothermia and improving patient
outcomes. This vital solution supports emergency teams by enhancing the efficiency and safety of
critical interventions, ultimately helping to save lives when every second counts.

[ Read more ][42]
[ Read more ][43]

### Bronchoscopy

Broncoflex offers advanced solutions for bronchoscopy with its innovative single-use bronchoscopes.
Designed for precision and ease of use, Broncoflex single use bronchoscopes provide high-quality
visualization and minimize the risk of cross-contamination. Ideal for both diagnostic and
therapeutic procedures, these reliable endoscopes enhance patient safety and efficiency in critical
care and surgical settings.

[ Read more ][44]
[ Read more ][45]

### Urology

In urology, using warmed irrigation fluid enhances patient comfort and maintains normothermia which
reduces the risk of hypothermia during procedures like TURP or cystoscopy. This solution not only
improves patient safety but also ensures smoother, more efficient procedures, especially late in the
list, leading to better overall results in urological care.

[ Read more ][46]
[ Read more ][47]
In the spotlight

## Broncoflex^{®} 5.6/3.0 XFlo

XFlo is the latest addition to the Broncoflex^{®} range, designed with the largest working channel
for its outer diameter to deliver best-in-class suction performance. Tailored to meet the
requirements of pulmonologists, intensivists and anesthesiologists, XFlo combines superior
ergonomics with high efficiency for both diagnostic and therapeutic procedures. Its single-use
design supports infection control by reducing cross-contamination risks while streamlining hospital
workflows and logistics through guaranteed sterility and ease of use.

## About TTP Group

TTP (originally named The Technology Partnership) was established in 1987 with a vision to create a
company focussed on developing products and technology for clients around the world, with a culture
driven by innovation, autonomy and collaboration.

As the company grew, TTP Group was formed to provide a vehicle for launching technology product
businesses created by TTP and in conjunction with our partners. Over 20 new businesses have been
created, some of which have been sold, merged with other companies or listed. Now over 30 years
later, the companies within TTP Group continue to develop break-through new products and
technologies to meet commercial needs.

Based outside Cambridge, UK, TTP Group has a strong sense of place. The vibrancy and tech innovation
which Cambridge is known for, has shaped the culture of the group and helped to attract world-class
talent.

Supporting the local community has always been part of the group’s ethos and TTP Group are long
standing supporters of initiatives such as Cambridge Literary Festival and the Cambridge Music
Festival – and TTP plc have been the headline sponsor of the TTP Cambridge Half Marathon since 2020.

Decades of experience in dialysis, innovative research, the global leader in dialysis services and
products – that is Fresenius Medical Care.

# Introducing the Nonin Health^{®} Platform

### Cloud-Based, Remote Access to Pulse Oximetry

Home-based oxygen qualification and overnight oximetry testing have long been constrained by
burdensome workflows, delayed access to data, and limited provider reimbursement. Nonin Medical’s
introduction of the Nonin Health® platform simplifies the process, reduces administrative and
logistical burden, and enables remote access to testing results so health care providers can deliver
more timely and cost-effective therapy.

[Learn More About the Platform][86] [Visit the Product Page][87]

# Introducing FDA-cleared performance

### at your fingertips

We are excited to introduce our FDA-cleared pulse oximeter: TruO2® OTC. It’s a medical-grade
fingertip oximeter that performs across all skin tones. TruO2® OTC provides equitable, accurate
blood oxygen and pulse readings for people with varying skin pigmentations, and it’s available over
the counter—no prescription required.

[TruO2 OTC Product Page][88] [Buy Now][89]

# Celebrating 40 Years of Innovation

### In Noninvasive Patient Monitoring

Since 1986, Nonin has been a trusted name in noninvasive patient monitoring, driven by our
commitment to accuracy, durability, and delivering actionable data to clinicians and patients
worldwide. Join us as we reflect on four decades of pioneering innovation and look forward to the
next chapter of innovation.

[Careers][84] * [Buy Now][85] # Introducing the Nonin Health^{®} Platform ### Cloud-Based, Remote Access to Pulse Oximetry Home-based oxygen qualification and overnight oximetry testing have long been constrained by burdensome workflows, delayed access to data, and limited provider reimbursement. Nonin Medical’s introduction of the Nonin Health® platform simplifies the process, reduces administrative and logistical burden, and enables remote access to testing results so health care providers can deliver more timely and cost-effective therapy. [Learn More About the Platform][86] [Visit the Product Page][87] # Introducing FDA-cleared performance ### at your fingertips We are excited to introduce our FDA-cleared pulse oximeter: TruO2® OTC. It’s a medical-grade fingertip oximeter that performs across all skin tones. TruO2® OTC provides equitable, accurate blood oxygen and pulse readings for people with varying skin pigmentations, and it’s available over the counter—no prescription required. [TruO2 OTC Product Page][88] [Buy Now][89] # Celebrating 40 Years of Innovation ### In Noninvasive Patient Monitoring Since 1986, Nonin has been a trusted name in noninvasive patient monitoring, driven by our commitment to accuracy, durability, and delivering actionable data to clinicians and patients worldwide. Join us as we reflect on four decades of pioneering innovation and look forward to the next chapter of innovation. [READ ABOUT OUR LEGACY][90] [Watch and celebrate 40 years][91] [Health & Safety][92] [Nonin Fingertip Solutions][93] [Sensor Compatibility Tool][94] ## **Count on Nonin** Our innovative, **nonin**vasive monitoring solutions work wherever and whenever you need them—even in challenging conditions—so you can concentrate on delivering the highest quality patient care. ## You work hard. ## **Your equipment should, too.** Your top priority is your patient—not troubleshooting medical devices. Our patient monitoring solutions are easy to use and provide consistent measurements time after time. Nonin pulse and regional oximeters, capnographs, and sensors deliver accurate data to help you focus on care. ### A history of **dependable solutions** We work constantly to improve our technologies and create monitoring solutions that deliver consistent performance in the most challenging conditions. We are committed to providing the critical information you need to make decisions, take action, and keep moving. ## Clinically proven technologies and field-tested solutions ## **designed to support the highest standards of care** [img] ### **Emergency Medicine** EMS professionals need equipment that stands up to frequent use, day and night. Nonin oximetry solutions are engineered to deliver reliable measurements every time. They give EMS specialists the data they need to take action quickly. [Learn More][95] [img] ### **Hospitals and Clinics** Clinicians rely on durable pulse oximetry monitoring devices to deliver quality patient care throughout the hospital. Nonin devices are designed to work wherever and whenever they are needed, so clinicians can make confident decisions. [Learn More][96] [img] ### **Original Equipment Manufacturers** Nonin is a leading global provider of OEM solutions in pulse and regional oximetry. Our easy-to-integrate components and dedicated support team have helped more than 200 OEM customers bring more than a million medical devices to market. [Learn More][97] ## Featured **Products** ### Nonin Health^{®} Platform Nonin Health^{®} is a secure, cloud-based platform that provides remote access to pulse oximetry data creating workflow efficiencies for your overnight oximetry tests. It seamlessly integrates with the WristOx2^{®} Model 3150BLE, giving healthcare providers streamlined and secure access to patient data for more informed decision-making. Designed for clinical efficiency from collection to analysis, the Nonin Health platform simplifies pulse oximetry workflows and helps support better patient management.¹ #### Cloud-Based **Data Management** Streamline workflows with secure, cloud-based access that eliminates manual transfers and reduces administrative time. #### **Patient-Centered** Accuracy Accurate SpO2 and pulse rate readings help support confident clinical decisions. [Learn More][98] [View All Products][99] [featured-img] ### Model 7500 The Nonin Model 7500 Pulse Oximeter empowers caregivers with reliable, accurate oximetry information^{2,3} — helping them act quickly and confidently in the moments that matter. Lightweight, compact, and portable, the 7500 is ideal for monitoring infant, pediatric, and adult patients in a variety of clinical and homecare settings and durable enough for heavy and repeated use. #### Easy to Use A variety of indicators ensure reliable reading: a color-coded pulse strength bar graph, pulse quality indicator, and sensor fault indicator #### Long **Battery Life** Operates on AC line voltage or an internal battery that provides 16 hour runtime with a 4 hour quick recharge [Learn More][100] [View All Products][101] [featured-img] ### Onyx^{®} Vantage 9590 The Onyx Vantage 9590 is a small, lightweight, portable device indicated for use in measuring and displaying functional oxygen saturation of arterial hemoglobin (%SpO2) and pulse rate of patients who are well or poorly perfused. Suitable for use in hospitals, clinics, long-term care facilities, skilled nursing facilities, emergency medical services, and home healthcare services. #### **Portable **Design Weighs less than two ounces and can be taken anywhere #### **Reliable** #### Measurements Provides up to 6,000 spot checks on two AAA batteries and includes a 4-year warranty [Learn More][102] [View All Products][103] [featured-img] * "As a respiratory therapist, I use Nonin products regularly. You could spend a little less on an oximeter at a drugstore or through an online medical supplier, but if you need accurate readings, Nonin is the only way to go.” [img-thumb] **John D., ** CRT, LPN * "Nonin’s Advance 8004CB sensor represents a major step forward in pediatric patient monitoring. Now, physicians have a single-sensor solution that provides oxygen saturation readings based on the child’s true physiology." [img-thumb] **Dean Kurth, MD** Cincinnati Children’s Hospital * “After thoroughly evaluating four manufacturers, we selected Nonin’s RespSense and LifeSense capnographs. These units best met our criteria of visible and portable monitors, warranty policies and consumables pricing.” [img-thumb] **Pam Lindemann** RT Manager, Riverside Medical Center * “I rely on my wrist-worn pulse oximeter to monitor my oxygen levels while racing. I need something durable with measurements I can trust; for me that’s a Nonin WristOx 3150.” [img-thumb] **Russell Winwood** Australian athlete with COPD ## PureSAT^{®} Pulse Oximetry Technology PureSAT signal processing technology—a Nonin exclusive—uses intelligent pulse-by-pulse filtering. This clinically proven technology provides precise oximetry measurements even in the presence of motion, low perfusion, or other challenging conditions. PureSAT automatically adjusts to each patient's condition to provide fast and reliable readings. [Learn More][104] ## Careers **with Nonin** [Open Positions][105] 1,2,3. Nonin Medical, Inc. # Redefining Healthcare Delivery

## Everywhere Care Happens

We are everywhere healthcare happens—and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow and beyond.

[About Baxter][37]
[Nurse helping patient in Baxter smart bed]

## The Future of Healthcare Is Connected

Connected care is no longer optional—it’s essential. We’re addressing the challenges of healthcare
by helping organizations integrate devices, streamline workflows and empower clinicians with data
that makes a difference.

[See How][38]

### $8B+

Inefficiencies, system downtimes and poor health IT integration have contributed to healthcare
industry losses exceeding $8 billion annually, up from $1.7 billion in 2017.¹

### 80%

While 8 out of 10 healthcare leaders see the clinical value in Internet of Things technologies,
integration with existing workflows is commonly cited as a top challenge.²

## Shaping the Future of Care

Driven by compassion and powered by innovation, we deliver connected solutions that transform
healthcare. By uniting life-saving technologies with the professionals who use them, we help improve
outcomes, streamline workflows and create meaningful advancements for patients everywhere.

[What We Do][39]

## Featured Insight

Is your AI triggering a second Copernican revolution?

There was a time when even the correct theory— the Copernican view of the universe—was not accepted.
It wasn’t accepted because people couldn’t explain why it was true.

See why breakthrough insights—then and now—depend on explanation, not just accuracy.

[ Read the full article ][86]

## Customer stories

[ Social Medical Corporation Genshukai ][87]

Achieve sustainable regional healthcare with AI and Fujitsu Data Intelligence PaaS. Optimize
management resources and streamline operations to improve profitability, reduce workload, and
enhance patient-centered medical services.

[ Estonian electronics company ][88]

Facing separation from its parent company, the manufacturer needed to quickly establish an
independent SAP system, ensuring uninterrupted production and long-term operational stability.

[ Nissin ][89]

achieving migration to SAP S/4HANA with BLUEFIELD and Near Zero Downtime.

### Axialer 360°-Absolutwertgeber PAM7940

[][82]

Die kompakten Sensorlösungen bieten hochpräzise Positionsmessung mit 360°-Erfassung und innovativer
MR-Sensortechnologie. Ein flacher Aufbau ermöglicht eine „True-Power-On“-Funktionalität mit
Auflösungen bis zu 21 Bit, während kalibrierte Systeme sogar bis zu 24 Bit erreichen. Mit
integrierten Korrekturalgorithmen und flexiblen Schnittstellen wie SPI, SSI oder BiSS-C eignen sie
sich ideal für Anwendungen in Robotik und flachen Motoren.

[Produktinfo zu PAM7940][83]

## Your Longevity in Your Control

##### our vision

We believe everyone deserves the opportunity to optimize their longevity and performance with actual
science-driven and golden-standard validated quality data.

From businesses to clinics, and consumers to family-care—everyone deserves the access, the quality
and the knowledge.

##### our mission

We want to redefine the power and utility of health data. When we focus on preventative we put the
quality of your longevity in your hands.
‍

We are bridging the gap between full personal physiological data access, knowledge of what your data
means, and how a momentary action can make a monumental change.

#### Transform your BioAge™

Our sedentary lifestyles have cost us—now it's time to reclaim control!
LifeQ gives you the core data with actual knowledge to understand the impact of your choices today,
so that you can have the power to control your biological aging tomorrow.

Be empowered with LifeQ, where you gain access to over 150 physiological biomarkers of your own
body, with real-time biometric feedback and even non-invasive disease screening! You can now
transform your daily habits into lifelong wellness.

Why wait to feel better tomorrow when you can start today?

#### Patient Adherence

Getting patients and participants to use devices correctly is one of the biggest hurdles in digital
health.

Vivalink's clinically validated, user-friendly wearables and an intuitive monitoring dashboard help
ensure consistent, compliant use.

##### BURDEN

#### Data Overload

Medical wearables generate massive streams of physiologic data—often too much for teams to manage
efficiently.

Our integrated platform reveals critical insights that enable faster, more informed decisions in
both patient care and clinical research.

##### FRICTION

#### System Integration

Data comes in many formats and rarely connects cleanly across systems, creating workflow delays and
operational drag.

We deliver standardized, integration-ready data formats for streamlined ingestion into existing
clinical, research, and analytics platforms.

measurement of activity, sleep and lifestyle. By combining participant centric wearables with validated, open algorithms, we deliver **higher quality data**, **faster time to insight**, and **effortless scalability **for research and public health. Our digital measures are used as **biomarkers** of disease, objective **clinical outcome assessments **and clinical trial **endpoints**. [VIEW OUR DIGITAL MEASURES][149] ## Global Public Health Delivering objective physical behaviour measurement into the global health community. As a dedicated contributor to open research, ActivInsights develop and validate algorithms to advance discoveries and improve health management. [Discover more][150] [Clinician in a clinical trial for Cardiology] ## Clinical Trials Robust evidence to support trial design. Cost-effective operationalisation through decentralisation. Enhanced data return rates with: real-time monitoring, reduced site and participant burden. [Discover more][151] ## Sleep Actigraphy Simplify and future-proof your at-home sleep measurement. Built for clinicians and researchers, offering next level analysis and instant reports. Streamlined sleep data visualisation and mark-up with objective sleep measures directly from high-resolution GENEActiv data files. [Discover more][152] [Purple Trainers] Our wearables are designed for long-term, low burden continuous monitoring. The **GENEActiv** provides unfiltered, high-resolution, sensor-level data and **ActivInsights Band **delivers activity, sleep and lifestyle data in real time. The **Study Management Hub **supports device, participant, site, device and data management with live adherence reporting. Our **Study and Training Services **are used globally to establish and complete successful studies. [VIEW OUR DIGITAL HEALTH TECHNOLOGIES][153] ### ActivInsights is Trusted by # Latest News & Insights * ## [Advancing digital endpoints in paediatric rare disease][154] 20 February 2026 Categories: [Insight][155], [News][156] Addressing silos in rare condition research. Today, there is no reliable biomarker or validated endpoint for STXBP1. # Ultralight & mobile patient monitoring technology

Universally available vital signs data with the cosinuss° patient monitoring solution:
First-in-class medically certified, 8.6 gramms in-ear sensor to monitor several vital parameters, in
combination with high-end software solutions to enable access to the data wherever the patient is.

[Contact us][30]
The displayed products and solutions on this website are not for sale in the US market. All claims
and the intended use are certified according to the Medical Device Regulation (MDR) in Europe.

## References

[Melanie Schade][31]2025-03-04T10:48:41+01:00

## [Mountain Rescue Upper Austria][34]

The weight, size and functionality of each device are of enormous importance in mountain rescue. The
ultra-light patient monitor from cosinuss° has proven to be a real game changer and has been used by
the teams of the Upper Austrian Mountain Rescue Service since the beginning of 2024.

[Melanie Schade][35]2025-02-28T13:23:07+01:00
[two soldiers presenting the c-med alpha]

#### [ Filling gaps in patient monitoring in challenging environments ][36]

[Medical][37]

## [Filling gaps in patient monitoring in challenging environments][38]

In close collaboration with several partners cosinuss° has delivered several sensor units to
frontline teams in Ukraine. Over the recent months we could gather invaluable feedback from the
users, using our system in military medical evacuation missions.

[Melanie Schade][39]2025-01-21T10:54:46+01:00
[An emergency doctor is flying a helicopter.]

#### [ Focusing on patient safety ][40]

[Medical][41]

## [Focusing on patient safety][42]

Martin Flugrettung has set a new standard in pre-hospital care with the introduction of cosinuss°'s
innovative patient monitoring solution. One year after the integration, it is clear to see how this
technology significantly improves the safety and well-being of patients and supports air rescuers in
their demanding work.

# Welcome to Dräger in India

**Turning technology into “Technology for Life”**

Dräger manufactures medical and safety technology products. In so doing, we protect, support, and
save people's lives around the world in hospitals, with fire departments, emergency services,
authorities, and in mining as well as industry. Founded in Lübeck in 1889, Dräger has grown into a
worldwide, listed enterprise in its fifth generation as a family-run business. Dräger has more than
16,000 employees worldwide and is present in over 190 countries around the globe. In 2023, the
company generated net sales of around EUR 3.4 billion.

Dräger technology is used all over the world. We operate in around 50 countries with our own sales
and service companies directly on location where our customers are.

Important Notice Regarding hearX Screening & Diagnostic Solutions

LXE Hearing has initiated an orderly wind-down of its U.S. operations, including the hearX Screening
& Diagnostic business.

**Current Services are Expected Through September 15, 2026**

A final service-termination date has not yet been confirmed. We will provide advance notice when it
is established.

**Take These Steps Now**
* Connect all hearX devices to the internet.
* Complete all pending data synchronizations.
* Export or print patient records, reports, and other information your organization needs to retain.
* Confirm that your organization’s current operational contact information is on file.
* Review all upcoming hearX transition communications.

**Important:** After cloud-connected services are discontinued, affected hearX devices and
applications may no longer operate, or may not operate as intended. Complete all data-preservation
and transition activities before the final service-termination date.

After that date, LXE Hearing will no longer provide product support, software updates, cloud-hosted
services, data synchronization, device management, troubleshooting, or continued-functionality
assurance.

For support questions please contact support@hearxgroup.com.

## Imagine a Healthier World

We believe the next generation won’t be defined by age, but by a world without heart attacks or
strokes. This is a world-changing mind-set we call Going for Zero™. We do our part through
technology supporting personal fitness, heart health, healthy lungs and freedom from pain. You bring
this commitment to life by understanding and sharing heart health with every step.
* [Going for Zero logo]

Free & Premium Options Available

## OMRON Connect

The next generation OMRON connect US/CAN/EMEA app is here and it syncs with every one of our
connected blood pressure monitors and select body composition monitors! This app release features
expanded insights and new look and feel for monitoring your heart health. By wirelessly connecting
via *Bluetooth™*, you can easily upload, store and even share your heart history data with family or
physicians. And it even keeps track of your weight—so you can achieve your broader health goals.

company.description: Sensirion is a manufacturer of smart sensor solutions, supporting megatrends such as energy transition, artificial intelligence, emission reduction, health and well-being, and the Internet of Things. The company offers a wide range of sensors for applications in medical technology, industry, semiconductors, logistics, life sciences, diagnostics, HVAC, appliances, consumer electronics, and mobility.

services: Customized sensor solutions (mechanical design-in, algorithm development, software integration)

data.intel: Sensirion positions itself as a leading provider of smart sensor solutions across multiple high-growth application areas. The company's product portfolio spans environmental, flow, and gas sensors, with a strong emphasis on environmental sensing for health, energy efficiency, and safety. Its 'more than 20 years of experience' indicates a mature organization with deep expertise in sensor development and manufacturing. The homepage highlights recent product launches (e.g., SGM5304 gas meter module, STC42A automotive H2 sensor) and certifications (EN 17526) that strengthen its market position. No specific customer names, financial figures, or employee counts are disclosed on this page, but the breadth of applications suggests a diversified customer base across medical, industrial, automotive, and consumer electronics sectors.

## Relentless innovation from the leaders in glucose health 

Dexcom has set the standard in glucose biosensing for 25 years and counting. Our best-in-class
technologies empower people to know what is happening in their bodies in real time, helping them to
better understand the many factors that impact their glucose and overall health.
Smart devices sold separately.^{‡}
* [Explore our portfolio][5]

## Dexcom G7 and Dexcom G7 15 Day—the world's most powerful CGM systems²

Dexcom G7 CGM Systems deliver proven results^{3-7} with best-in-class accuracy² and a growing
ecosystem of connected partners that help ease the burden of living with diabetes. They’re designed
for all types of diabetes, sending glucose numbers to your phone^{*} or receiver in real time,
giving you the knowledge to better control diabetes for healthier tomorrows.^{8,9}
* [Explore Dexcom G7][6]
[Man walking outside while wearing Stelo sensor]
[Stelo sensor]

## Stelo Glucose Biosensor

Get 24/7 insights into how food, exercise, stress, and sleep affect your body, so you can build
habits that power lasting health.^{10,11}
No prescription. FSA/HSA eligible.
* [Learn more][7]
[Woman walking with a friend outside while wearing sensor]

## Empowering people to take control of health 

Since 1999, Dexcom has been developing innovative technology that has transformed how people manage
diabetes and track their glucose. We think of ourselves as partners in their journey, empowering
them to live confidently and take control of their health with our life-changing products.
* [More about Dexcom][8]


### Get Started with Dexcom

Take the first step towards better health! Glucose health is a critical part of overall health, and
Dexcom has the best sensing solution for you or your loved one regardless of your health goals.
We'll make getting started easy from the comfort of your home.

The Stelo Glucose Biosensor System may also help the user better understand how lifestyle and behavior modification, including diet and exercise, impact glucose excursion. The user is not intended to take medical action based on the device output without consultation with a qualified healthcare professional. intel.summary:
Abbott has been a part of India's healthcare landscape since 1910, making it one of the oldest and
most established health companies in the country. With more than 12,000 employees working across
urban centers and rural communities alike, Abbott India serves a vast and varied population —
offering over 400 trusted pharmaceutical brands alongside nutritional products, medical devices and
diagnostic solutions. The company's headquarters in Mumbai anchors a network that reaches into
practically every corner of the subcontinent, reflecting a belief that world-class healthcare should
not be a privilege reserved for the few. 

Abbott India Limited, a publicly listed subsidiary of Abbott Laboratories, is one of India's
fastest-growing pharmaceutical companies and a recognized leader in women's health,
gastroenterology, metabolic conditions, neurology and vaccines. The company has invested in local
manufacturing for its two largest businesses — nutrition and pharmaceuticals — because building for
India means building in India. That commitment to local production ensures that products are
designed and made with the specific needs of Indian consumers in mind, from the nutritional
requirements of infants and young children to the health challenges facing aging adults. 

For more than 115 years, Abbott in India has strived to be closer to the people it serves. That
closeness shapes everything — the products developed, the communities supported and the partnerships
forged with healthcare professionals across the country. From creating excellent workplaces
recognized by leading industry bodies to addressing the health needs of both rural and urban
populations, Abbott in India takes pride in the lasting difference it makes every day.

Corsano is currently involved in over 100 clinical trials – **Cardiovascular, Oncology and Stress**. Corsano’s medically certified wearables increase credibility of studies and prepare for medical digital therapies. Corsano’s involvement in important clinical trial research consortia accelerates the pace of medical research, enabling the discovery of new biomarkers and their clinical validation. ## Real-time Remote Patient Monitoring Corsano CardioWatch 287 can monitor up to 19 Vital Parameters in real-time while post-discharge programs often rely solely on episodic vitals (spot measurements). Healthcare providers can develop **personalized treatment plans** that address the unique needs of each patient. Corsano can provide patients with real-time feedback on their progress, which can help motivate them to adhere to their treatment plan. Remote care-at-home programs deliver improved clinical outcomes, lower costs and better patient experience: **38% ****reduction in cost of care****; ****70% ****reduction in readmissions**; **50%**** improvement in patient mobility** ## In-Hospital Monitoring # Uninterrupted Ambulatory Monitoring #### Remote Patient Monitoring ### CardioWatch is the smallest multi sensor medical bracelet to provide care in a patient’s home ### though continuous, remote monitoring ### ### Detect impending rehospitalization with a predictive accuracy comparable to implanted devices ### ### Studies indicate that patients experience improved outcomes with hospital-at-home services ### compared to conventional hospital stays # Early detection of patient # deterioration ### In-Hospital Monitoring ### Patient deterioration between routine nurse observation rounds can go undetected for hours, ### resulting in severe and expensive outcomes. ### ### Corsano’s monitoring and smart algorithms provide reliable data to support clinical decisions ### and detect the earliest signs of patient deterioration. ## Testimonials  First, I wanted to let you and the Corsano team know how very impressed I am with your device. To be successful in business and life, a relationship has to be a two way street with give and take. At Corsano, we believe in cultivating good working relationships with our partners. We don’t limit ourselves to a select few, but always attempt to find the best possible partners. Corsano develops and manufactures medical wearables for research and patient care, that is our core business. Our open strategy is to connect CardioWatch to partner platforms and systems via APIs and SDKs. We provide access to raw and processed data to partners enabling them to offer a variety of medical research and patient care services. As such, we deal with hospitals, CROs, associations and companies worldwide.   Dozee works on the principles of ballistocardiography - the Dozee sensor sheet placed under your
  mattress captures the micro-vibrations that are emitted from the body through heartbeats,
  respiration cycle, and body movement. The data is sent to the secure cloud which converts it into
  meaningful bio-markers. The processed vitals information can be accessed on the SecureRPM
  applications.

company.name: VitalConnect
company.description: VitalConnect is a healthcare technology company specializing in remote cardiac monitoring and remote patient monitoring solutions. Its products include the VitalPatch RTM extended Holter and the VitalConnect Solution platform, which streams up to 11 patient vitals in real time.

products.name: VitalPatch RTM
products.description: First-of-its-kind extended Holter technology for cardiac monitoring. Provides full access cardiac monitoring and measures key vital signs including a live ECG, allowing physicians to monitor patients while they recover at home.

products.name: VitalConnect Solution
products.description: Telehealth-enabled software platform with real-time streaming of up to 11 patient vitals. Used for in-hospital and at-home monitoring, including for COVID-19 patients, to optimize care delivery and minimize caregiver exposure.

key_numbers: real-time streaming of up to 11 patient vitals

data.intel: VitalConnect is a healthcare technology company focused on remote cardiac monitoring and patient vitals streaming. It differentiates through real-time streaming of up to 11 patient vitals and hospital-at-home capabilities. The company experienced accelerated growth in 2021 due to COVID-19-driven telehealth adoption. Key milestones include the launch of VitalPatch RTM in November 2020 and the start of the TELESTAR-TAVR clinical study in September 2020. Notably, iRhythm has announced plans to acquire VitalConnect, signaling consolidation in the cardiac monitoring market. This acquisition could expand iRhythm's reach into remote patient monitoring and hospital-at-home settings.

# Heart disease detection in one minute *using a smartphone*

Software as a medical device for self-monitoring, remote care, and point-of-care diagnostics.

## A medical device on your smartphone

Experience effortless heart health monitoring with a CE-marked Class IIb medical device designed to
detect signs of atrial fibrillation—right from your smartphone.
* **1-Minute Measurement**: Check your heart health anytime, anywhere in just 60 seconds.
* **Clinically Validated Technology**: Powered by gyrocardiography, a proven method for tracking
  heart motion.
* **Trusted and Regulated**: Certified as a Class IIb medical device under EU regulation.
  
  **Available In**: Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Ireland, Italy,
  Netherlands, Norway, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland and the United Kingdom.

#### Self-monitoring

**For you. **Age or a chronic condition can increase the risk of developing atrial fibrillation.

[**The CardioSignal app**][79]

#### Population Health

**For care providers. **A digital atrial fibrillation detection program for targeted or
population-wide health initiatives.

[**A-Fib detection programs**][80]

#### Point-of-Care

**In the clinic. **Reducing atrial fibrillation related burden in clinical practice.

[**Point-of-care solutions**][81]

## *Patented*
## motion sensor
## technology

#### Scientific basis

Technology based on 12+ years of academic research and 20+ peer-reviewed publications

#### Method

Gyrocardiography, a non-invasive technique for measuring heart motion with a gyroscope and
accelerometer

#### Clinical studies

Validated in clinical studies, with continuous focus on academic collaboration

[ Get to know the technology ][82]

CardioSignal is a CE marked class IIb medical device. CE marking indicates that a product has been
assessed by the manufacturer and deemed to meet EU safety, health and environmental protection
requirements.
* ISO27001-certified for information security
* ISO13485-certified medical device company

## Commitment to quality & privacy

## Contact us

Professional: Do you need further information or want to receive a demo? Provide your details, and
we will contact you shortly.

For assistance with the CardioSignal application, please contact our customer support directly at
[support@cardiosignal.com][83].

[ Learn more ][72] [ Patient support ][73] ## Clarity That Drives Confidence Through advanced monitoring technology, intelligent algorithms, and expert clinical review, iRhythm delivers meaningful, actionable data — helping clinicians diagnose with greater confidence from the start.¹ [ See the proof ][74] ### Improved wear experience Zio ECG monitors are designed to be comfortable^{2-3} and easy to wear^{3-4} for better patient satisfaction and compliance^{2-3} [Patient wearing Zio monitor] ## Outstanding patient compliance Near-perfect patient compliance⁵ generates high-quality, actionable data¹ ### Remarkable clinical outcomes Compared to other monitoring services, including long-term continuous monitors (LTCMs), the iRhythm LTCM service is a continuous, uninterrupted¹⁰ cardiac monitor associated with: Highest diagnostic yield of specified arrhythmias^{6-10} Lowest likelihood of retesting^{6-10} ## More than a monitor The iRhythm monitoring service delivers clarity at every step — from the moment a Zio® ECG monitor is prescribed and worn, through advanced AI-assisted analysis and expert review, to physician-ready, clinically actionable reports. With intuitive tools like the ZioSuite® portal, seamless EHR integration, and patient-centric support via the MyZio® app, the iRhythm monitoring service helps simplify workflows and bring meaningful insight to your practice. [ Discover the patient app ][79] [User researching iRhythm on computer] #### Incredible 99% physician agreement with end-of-wear reports The iRhythm monitoring service combines the first FDA-cleared, deep-learned algorithm verified by QCTs^{12-15} to generate reports with 99% physician agreement,¹⁶ which can lead to an accurate and more timely diagnosis.^{1,6-10} Over 12 million patients analyzed¹⁷ Over 2 billion hours of curated heartbeat data⁴ Comprehensive reports verified by QCTs^{12-15} [ Learn more about advanced AI ][80] [ Contact us ][81] ## Keep reading Clinical Article Russo P, Coetzer H, Hendrickson EM, Boyle K, Wright B., Am J Manag Care. 2025 Assessment of Variation in Ambulatory Cardiac Monitoring (AVALON) Study A retrospective study of analyzing commercially insured patient populations, examined how monitoring strategy influenced arrhythmia diagnosis, clinical outcomes, and healthcare resource utilization. company.description: Isansys offers the Patient Status Engine (PSE), an FDA-cleared wireless patient monitoring platform for real-time physiological data capture and analysis. The platform targets hospitals, care facilities, and home care settings, with a focus on improving patient safety, reducing ICU readmissions, and enabling predictive analytics.

products.name: Patient Status Engine (PSE)
features: Real-time physiological data capture and analysis
Universal data capture for all patient monitoring and analysis
Secure data transmission with industry standard encryption

products.name: Wireless Sensors
features: Measures heart rate, respiration rate, heart rate variability, temperature, oxygen saturation
Continuous or periodic ECG and PPG

products.name: Bedside Gateway
features: Complete visibility of patient health status and early warning score
Continuous real-time vital sign data upload

products.name: Remote Lifeguard
features: Access to patient data from secure local or cloud server
Live control center for 24/7 remote monitoring
Real-time patient data and early warning indicators on computers, tablets, laptops, mobiles

products.name: Lifeguard Server
features: Open API for connectivity to electronic medical records and hospital information systems

products.name: Notification Service
features: Provides notifications to care teams via SMS messaging, WhatsApp, or proprietary provider apps

data.intel: Isansys is positioning the Patient Status Engine as a comprehensive wireless monitoring platform for healthcare providers, emphasizing FDA clearance, all-wireless freedom, and future-proof scalability. The website highlights benefits such as reduced ICU readmissions, fewer code blue events, and nursing time savings, but lacks specific quantified metrics or named customer references. To enhance market credibility and accelerate adoption, Isansys should publish concrete outcome data, detailed case studies, and return-on-investment figures. The open API and EMR integration capabilities are significant technical strengths that could be amplified to appeal to hospital IT decision-makers. The mention of home care settings indicates a potential expansion area beyond acute hospital environments.

* # **Our mission is to improve health through advances in neurotechnology**
* # **We introduced the first wearable nerve stimulator for managing chronic pain**
* # **We invented the concept of automated nerve testing**
* # **We seek to define new product categories and leapfrog existing technology**

## We are an innovation-driven company focused on the development and global commercialization of
## non-invasive medical devices for the diagnosis and treatment of pain and neurological disorders.
* [Fibromyalgia]
  
  ### Fibromyalgia
  
  Our **Quell® Fibromyalgia** device is an advanced wearable neuromodulator. It is the first and
  only FDA authorized medical device that helps reduce the symptoms of fibromyalgia.

## Over 5 million people worldwide have benefited from NeuroMetrix healthcare products
* [contact][5]

*Unpaid testimonial. In a 60-day home use test conducted among 88 Quell users with lower extremity
and/or low back pain, the majority of participants reported an improvement in their pain with
regular use of the device. Results may vary.

COOKIE SETTINGS

ownership of electroCore, NeuroMetrix will continue to provide its Quell products and services under
its established brand. Our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy have been updated to reflect this
change. Please review these updates to understand how this new relationship may affect your
experience with us. If you have any questions, please contact us at 888-903-2673.

company.description: The power of DNA testing for everyone. Spartan Bioscience is a Canadian biotechnology company and world leader in on-demand DNA testing. The technology is FDA approved and developed according to ISO 13485 quality system. Their products have been validated by the CDC and Mayo Clinic. Customers include hospitals and Fortune 500 companies.

data.intel: Spartan Bioscience is a Canadian biotech company specializing in rapid point-of-care DNA testing. Its core product, the Spartan Cube, is the world's smallest DNA analyzer and has received FDA approval, making it a credible player in the diagnostics market. The company is expanding into COVID-19 testing and has established a European Scientific Advisory Board and a partnership with Angiocare to enter the European cardiac stent precision medicine market. With validation from the CDC and Mayo Clinic, Spartan is well-positioned to target hospitals and Fortune 500 companies. The key competitive advantages are speed (results in 1 hour) and portability, which differentiate it from centralized lab testing.

intel.synthesis: Biofourmis is a connected care technology platform partnering with health systems, hospitals, payers, and life science companies. It focuses on making home the site of care through solutions like Hospital at Home, Timely Discharge, SNF at Home, and Remote Patient Management. The company reports strong outcomes including 70% reduction in 30-day readmissions and up to 38% cost reduction. It announced a merger with CopilotIQ to create an end-to-end platform for AI-driven in-home care, and has recently been selected by AdventHealth and Lee Health for acute care-at-home and remote patient monitoring programs.
intel.actionable_insights: Biofourmis is expanding its footprint in hospital-at-home and remote patient monitoring, evidenced by recent partnerships with AdventHealth and Lee Health. The merger with CopilotIQ indicates a strategic push toward end-to-end AI-driven in-home care. The sale of its life science business to ActiGraph may signal a refocus on care delivery solutions.

company.name: Kenzen Group Inc.
company.description: Kenzen is a global occupational health and safety professional services company that helps organizations manage workplace risks and create positive change in workforce health, safety and performance.

services.name: Next-gen HSE +P Solutions
services.features: Investing in a culture of safety and readiness has a direct impact on operational efficiency, employee retention, and profitability.

services.name: Performance & Fitness for Duty
services.features: Prevention-first strategies that empower peak performance amidst challenging environments and high risk tasks.

services.name: Occupational Health & Safety
services.features: Whole-person physical and mental readiness for optimal health and safety outcomes on and off the job.

services.name: Systems & Digital Transformation
services.features: Intelligent systems and processes that enable easy compliance, robust reporting and actionable insights.

services.name: Heat Stress & Illness Management
services.features: Addresses heat-related productivity losses and heat illness, a leading cause of preventable incidents in industries like Construction and Agriculture.

services.name: Smart HSE Systems
services.features: Smart occupational health and safety systems integrating digital tools, predictive analytics, and real-time monitoring to deliver measurable business value beyond compliance.

services.name: Workforce Health & Safety
services.features: Proactive health and whole-person readiness programs that reduce lost time, insurance premiums, and liability exposure, and boost engagement and productivity.

services.name: The Kenzen Way Methodology
services.features: Step-by-step approach: leverage whole-person readiness; quantify bottom-line and ensure positive ROI; integrate smart data-driven monitoring and predictive analytics; become architects of adoption.

key_numbers: Fatigue and heat stress cause 30%+ of workplace injuries
Proactive health and readiness strategies reduce safety incidents by up to 40%
Performance Gain: 30% improvement in operational efficiency
Every day, preventable incidents cost businesses millions
Decades of combined experience across multiple critical disciplines

data.intel: Kenzen positions itself as a next-generation HSE+P professional services firm, emphasizing whole-person readiness, predictive analytics, and measurable ROI. The content highlights strong value propositions (up to 40% incident reduction, >3x ROI) and target industries including construction, agriculture, energy, manufacturing, and healthcare. Key differentiators include combining occupational health, safety, and performance with digital transformation and systems thinking. The absence of named customers, investors, and leadership in the provided content suggests a need to explore deeper pages for relationship and people data.

# Protect Your Feet. Protect Your Mobility.

## Real-Time Support for Every Step

Foot complications can lead to infection, hospitalization, and amputation, but many risk factors can
be identified before they become serious.¹

The Orpyx^{®} System helps individuals with impaired protective sensation recognize and respond to
sustained plantar pressure during everyday activities. Through real-time alerts and a live foot
pressure map, the system encourages timely offloading to help reduce repeated pressure exposure that
can contribute to ischemia and tissue breakdown.

With optional Continuous Foot Monitoring services, Orpyx also helps extend care beyond the clinic,
supporting proactive foot health management every day.

## About Orpyx

## A Smarter Way to Protect Every Step

The Orpyx System delivers real-time pressure alerts enabling immediate offloading.
The Technology Personalized Data Collection Optional Services
The Technology

##### Designed for Those at Risk of Foot Complications

The Orpyx System includes Footbeds, a Receiver, and a Hub that work together to provide real-time
alerts for immediate patient-directed pressure offloading.

Personalized Data Collection

##### Turning Daily Activity Into Real-Time Support

Plantar pressure and activity data are passively collected during daily activities to support your
foot health between visits.

Optional Services

##### Care Doesn’t Stop Between Medical Appointments

Our optional Continuous Foot Monitoring services uses foot health data from the Orpyx System to help
users stay connected with their provider between appointments. The Orpyx remote nursing team
provides coaching, support, and early intervention when needed.

## A New Approach to Foot Health

Orpyx is committed to improving foot health management by supporting real-time pressure awareness
and proactive offloading. Our mission is to help people with loss of protective sensation stay aware
of sustained pressure events so they can take timely action and work with their care team to support
their foot health.

**We’re in this together. Every step of the way.**

[ Our Mission ][4]

# A evolução do diagnóstico do sono

[Sensor Bodystar] [Sensor Oxistar 2] Apneia posicional Estágios do sono Sensor ergonômico

Precisão clínica, conforto e praticidade em uma solução criada para transformar o diagnóstico
domiciliar da apneia do sono.

[Quero ser um Centro Credenciado][21] [Encontrar um centro ][22]

## O auge da inovação médica

### Oxistar® 2
### A tecnologia em evolução

[Oxistar 2]
* Mais conforto no uso
  
  Sensor compacto que envolve o dedo com suavidade, garantindo estabilidade e conforto durante toda
  a noite.
* Oximetria de Alta Resolução
  
  Tecnologia validada para captar variações sutis na oxigenação que a oximetria tradicional pode não
  identificar.
* Dados clínicos mais completos
  
  O algoritmo agora realiza a classificação das fases do sono (Leve, Profundo, REM) e analisa a
  Variabilidade da Frequência Cardíaca (VFC).
* Carregamento rápido
  
  Conectividade moderna USB-C e bateria de alta autonomia para até 30 horas de monitoramento
  contínuo.

### Bodystar®

### Seu sensor de posição

[Bodystar]
* Design confortável
  
  Uma alternativa mais simples e confortável para o diagnóstico da apneia do sono posicional, sem
  limitar os movimentos naturais durante a noite.
* Análise Posicional
  
  Relaciona com precisão as dessaturações de oxigênio e a intensidade do ronco às posições supina,
  prona e laterais direita e esquerda.
* Sincronia inteligente
  
  Conexão simplificada com os sensores Oxistar e o Aplicativo Biologix.
* Autonomia prolongada
  
  Até 60 horas de bateria e carregamento rápido em 1,5 hora para mais praticidade na rotina de
  exames.

## Jornada conectada do início ao fim

[conforto-preservado]

**Conforto em primeiro lugar**
Dispositivos leves, ergonômicos e discretos permitem a realização de exames de forma não invasiva e
sem interferência na rotina de descanso.

[autonomia-assistida]

**Exame feito com o app**
O Exame do Sono Biologix® é realizado com o sensor Oxistar®, o aplicativo Biologix e, quando
indicado, o sensor Bodystar®.

[simplicidade-operacional]

**Informações integradas**
Os dados coletados são enviados à plataforma Biologix, analisados automaticamente e disponibilizados
no Portal Biologix para interpretação profissional.

Desenvolvemos soluções que combinam precisão clínica, conforto e praticidade pra quem realiza o
exame e para quem acompanha os resultados.

### The Future of Blood Pressure Monitoring is Cuffless.

Introducing the Oxitone 2000M – The next-generation wrist-worn monitor for continuous blood pressure
and vitals.

[Discover Oxitone 2000M][21]

## Mind and Data Against Disease

The Oxitone 2000M is a next-generation medical device that delivers a holistic view of patient
health through continuous, automated monitoring.
 
[[Oxitone_server,overnight report,app and device]][23]
 
[Blood]

## Cuffless Blood Pressure:

Frequent systolic and diastolic measurements.

[Cardiac]

## Cardiac Health:

Pulse rate, Heart Rate Variability (HRV), and Cardiac Output.

[respiratory]

## Respiratory:

Blood Oxygen (SpO2) and Respiratory Rate.

[Wellness]

## Wellness:

Skin temperature, Sleep patterns, Activity/Steps, and Dehydration monitoring

## Who We Serve

20% of severe chronic patients consume 80% of healthcare expenses and clinician’s time while causing
stress, anxiety and frustration. The available solutions produce incomplete patient data leading to
overburdened decision-making processes. With Oxitone, clinicians effortlessly helps thousands of
high-risk patients just in one click.
[IconsNew1c]

Able to generate critical information and enhance clinical outcomes

Able to develop effective care management strategies and mitigate risks

[More][25]

## Pharma & CRO

Able to collect and analyze hyper-personalized physiological effects of drugs

### Traditional Remote Care
* Episodic occasional data
* Off-line clinical response
* Threshold-based alert
* Costly, “manual” follow-up

[NewArrow]

### Continuous Remote Care
* Real-time data
* Ensure continuous care flow
* Enable AI-powered predictive care
* Enable “Automated” follow-up

## Why Oxitone

Oxitone boosts value-based healthcare by delivering extraordinary patient, clinical and economical
outcomes at reduced medical utilization and cost. Patients need a prompt response to emergencies.
Physicians need an easy and timely follow-up with patients. Our mission is to transform chronic
disease management.
[IconsNew2a]

## Innovative Technology

Patented wrist ulna-bone multi-parameter medical biosensors

[IconsNew2b]

Unique AI algorithms to automate follow-up with patients (Not available for sale in the U.S.)

Tandem Diabetes Care automated insulin delivery systems are now powered by Control-IQ+ technology —

This insulin pump can be worn almost anywhere,* giving you more options for how you manage your
diabetes. It’s powered by Control-IQ+ technology and is controllable with a compatible, personal

Diabetes Technol Ther. 2023;25(5):329-342. **Important Safety Information** RX ONLY. **Indications for Use** **Tandem Mobi system:** The Tandem Mobi insulin pump with interoperable technology (the pump) is intended for the subcutaneous delivery of insulin, at set and variable rates, for the management of diabetes mellitus in persons requiring insulin. The Pump is able to reliably and securely communicate with compatible, digitally connected devices, including automated insulin dosing software, to receive, execute, and confirm commands from these devices. The pump is indicated for use in persons 2 years of age and greater. **t:slim X2 insulin pump:** The t:slim X2 insulin pump with interoperable technology (the pump) is intended for the subcutaneous delivery of insulin, at set and variable rates, for the management of diabetes mellitus in persons requiring insulin. The pump is able to reliably and securely communicate with compatible, digitally connected devices, including automated insulin dosing software, to receive, execute, and confirm commands from these devices. The pump is indicated for use in persons 2 years of age and greater. **Control-IQ+ technology:** Control-IQ+ technology is intended for use with compatible integrated continuous glucose monitors (iCGM, sold separately) and alternate controller enabled (ACE) pumps to automatically increase, decrease, and suspend delivery of basal insulin based on iCGM readings and predicted glucose values. It can also deliver correction boluses when the glucose value is predicted to exceed a predefined threshold. Control-IQ+ technology is intended for the management of type 1 diabetes mellitus in persons 2 years of age and greater and of type 2 diabetes mellitus in persons 18 years of age and greater. **Warning:** Control-IQ+ technology should not be used in anyone under the age of 2 years old with type 1 diabetes or under the age of 18 years old with type 2 diabetes. It should also not be used in patients who require less than a total daily insulin dose of 5 units of insulin per day or who weigh less than 20 pounds (9 kilograms), as those are the required minimum values needed for Control-IQ+ to operate safely. Users of the pump and Control-IQ+ must: use the insulin pump, iCGM, and all other system components in accordance with their respective instructions for use. Failure to follow these instructions for use could result in an over delivery or under delivery of insulin. This can cause hypoglycemia (low BG) or hyperglycemia (high BG) events. Visit [tandemdiabetes.com/safetyinfo][19] for additional important safety information. **FreeStyle Libre 3 Plus sensor:** For FreeStyle Libre 3 Plus sensor safety information, please visit [freestyle.abbott/us-en/safety-information][20]. data.intel: Vital Beats is a Danish health-tech startup focused on automating remote monitoring of cardiac device patients. Its platform promises to reduce clinician workload by automatically triaging patients and handling routine cases, while emphasizing GDPR compliance and cloud security. The company was founded by university scientists with expertise in cardiac device treatment. Given its niche in cardiology and early-stage signals (founded 2018), potential growth areas include expanding into additional chronic disease monitoring or broader European markets.

## Neste generasjon helsemonitorering

Vitalthings Guardian H10 er neste generasjon helsemonitorering for brukervennlig og proaktiv
oppfølging av brukere i helsetjenesten – kontaktløs, og helt uten bruk av kamera eller sensorikk på
kroppen.

Vitalthings Guardian H10 er klargjort for medisinske tjenester for bruk på institusjoner og i
hjemmet.

##### VITALTHINGS GUARDIAN M10

## Fremtidens pasientmonitor

Vitalthings Guardian M10 markerer et generasjonsskifte innen pasientmonitorering.

Kontaktløs og kontinuerlig måling av vitale parametere gir store fordeler for pasienter og
helsepersonell.

Medisinsk godkjent i risikoklasse IIb.

[+][35]

##### VITALTHINGS GUARDIAN VIEW

## Forebygger alarmtretthet

Vitalthings Guardian View gir sanntidsoversikt og alarmer med mulighet for direkte alarmhåndtering
for opptil 20 pasienter samlet i én skjermvisning.

Vitlathings Guardian View er klassifisert som tilbehør til medisinsk utstyr,

##### Vitalthings Somnofy

## Vær i forkant med pålitelig digitalt tilsyn

Vitalthings Somnofy  brukes i dag primært i  forskning, og måler tilstedeværelse, søvn og uro
kontinuerlig gjennom natten, i tillegg til et individuellt snitt på pustefrekvens.

Helsepersonell får tilgang til statusoversikt og nattrapport samt kan motta varsler ved ulike avvik.

Alle målinger skjer kontaktløst og uten bruk av kamera.

[+][37]

##### Bruksområder

## Økt pasientsikkerhet
## og en bedre arbeidshverdag

I tett samarbeid med sykehus og institusjoner utvikler vi teknologi og tjenester for ulike
bruksområder.

Vårt mål er å forenkle og effektivisere arbeidshverdagen for helsepersonell, samt øke  livskvalitet
og trygghet for tjenestemottakere.

## Optimaliser fysisk og mental helse med god søvn

En god natts søvn spiller en avgjørende rolle for å fremme både fysisk og mental helse, mens dårlig
søvnkvalitet har tilsvarende negative effekter.

Ved å fokusere på tiltak som bidrar til å forbedre søvnkvaliteten, har vi muligheten til å
optimalisere faktorer som oppmerksomhet, læring og opprettholdelse av en stabil kroppsvekt på tvers
av aldersgrupper.

[+][38] \ ### Sykehus \ ### Psykiatri \ ### Rusomsorg \ ### Hjemmetjeneste \ ### Sykehjem og omsorgsbolig \ ### Forskning ## Optimaliser fysisk og mental helse med god søvn En god natts søvn spiller en avgjørende rolle for å fremme både fysisk og mental helse, mens dårlig søvnkvalitet har tilsvarende negative effekter. Ved å fokusere på tiltak som bidrar til å forbedre søvnkvaliteten, har vi muligheten til å optimalisere faktorer som oppmerksomhet, læring og opprettholdelse av en stabil kroppsvekt på tvers av aldersgrupper. ## Aktuelt #### Nyheter [[Vitalthings lanserer Guardian View – utvider plattform for pasientmonitorering]][39] #### [Vitalthings lanserer Guardian View – utvider plattform for pasientmonitorering][40] jun 24, 2026 Guardian View er et nytt distribuert alarmsystem som gir helsepersonell sanntidsoversikt og muliggjør ressursbesparende pasientmonitorering, samtidig som det motvirker alarmtretthet. Flere sykehus i Norge og Tyskland er allerede klare til å ta i bruk den nye løsningen. Getting patients and participants to use devices correctly is one of the biggest hurdles in digital
health.

Vivalink's clinically validated, user-friendly wearables and an intuitive monitoring dashboard help
ensure consistent, compliant use.

#### Data Overload

Medical wearables generate massive streams of physiologic data—often too much for teams to manage
efficiently.

Our integrated platform reveals critical insights that enable faster, more informed decisions in

#### System Integration

Data comes in many formats and rarely connects cleanly across systems, creating workflow delays and
operational drag.

We deliver standardized, integration-ready data formats for streamlined ingestion into existing

# Digital Health Engagement in Diverse Populations

Overstretched health workers. Diseases no one wants to talk about. Complicated procedures and
systems. Lifestyle change requirements.

Navigating healthcare can be confusing and intimidating. Many give up.

**Aviro creates digital solutions that engage and empower diverse patients and health workers, so
that care providers and researchers get critical data/insights and so that more patients access and
stay in trials and in care.**

We help people to find good health easily, every day.

# Smart healthcare for people

Access to healthcare is limited and unequally distributed. As Africans, we understand this challenge
personally.

**Aviro is an African social enterprise that creates great digital health solutions by carefully
listening to the needs of diverse patients and providers and translating these, using science and
technology, into effective and caring interactions.**

Over a decade, we've partnered with numerous NGOs, government health departments, and pharmaceutical
companies to drive health equity and to increase patient-level data/insights for measurable impact
aligned with SDGs.

Smart empathetic systems mean that surprisingly simple access to health can be everyone’s
experience.
‍

‍**We won’t stop until it is.**

# Technology designed for measurable
# impact

With a track record of serving **100,000+ patients **while collecting robust and secure data, we
have the evidence to show we can deliver:
‍

- Improved service uptake
- Enhanced education for healthcare workers and patients
- Quality assurance of health worker protocols
- Streamlined data collection through process automation
- Increased patient feedback that leads to continuous quality improvement

## A platform for secure, effective delivery

We take a real-world, user-centric design approach to everything we do. This means that our health
experiences  are not only informative, but also engaging and relatable. When communication resonates
with patients and healthcare workers, it leads to better outcomes.

The Aviro Pocket Clinic is our technology platform to support inclusive patient engagement and
outcomes. It offers a user-friendly experience while seamlessly integrating data collection into the
care workflow. This reduces frustration while providing robust real-time feedback, insights, and
analytics that enable rapid improvements and clearer view of the bigger picture for care providers.

[See the product][7][Request a demo][8]

# BodyGuardian™ remote cardiac monitor

A comfortable, waterproof heart monitor that patients can wear 24/7. A powerful remote ECG device
that delivers the data physicians require.

## BodyGuardian for patients

The small, wearable monitor that lets you get on with your life while collecting data your physician
will need to make a diagnosis.

[Girl underwater while wearing monitor.]
[ Learn more about BodyGuardian for patients ][48]

## BodyGuardian portfolio for physicians

BodyGuardian features robust data collection, a wide range of electronic medical record integrations
(EMR), and a choice of business models.

[Healthcare providers looking at remote cardiac monitor data on monitor.]
[ Learn more about BodyGuardian for physicians ][49]
[ BODYGUARDIAN: Indications, Safety and Warnings ][50]

The system provides early warnings on bed exit to prevent falls before they happen

VITALERTER tracks bed-time and turn movements and provides real-time turn reminders and reports

## Modern Rehab Needs Modern Tools

We help care teams and rehabilitation professionals cut through inefficiencies, track progress, and
focus on what matters most— delivering exceptional care to their patients.

[Conceptual illustration symbolizing the growth of the aging population.]

**Growing Aging Population**

There will be 84M people older than 65 in the US by 2054 which equates to 23% of the overall
population.

[Conceptual illustration symbolizing limited resources with abstract shapes and constrained
elements.]

**Limited Resources**

There are only 270,000 Physical Therapists in the US. Over 20,000 retired after the pandemic. We
need over 12,000 more to serve the growing demand.

[“Conceptual illustration representing a lack of quantified data]

**Lack of Quantified Data**

Limited access to patient data and advanced diagnostics, especially in smaller or rural clinics.

## *Sensoria Health contributes to solve these problems with agentic AI sensor to cloud remote
## patient monitoring (RPM).*

## Agentic AI-Powered Solutions for Better Patient Outcomes

Clinically validated devices and software solutions that track adherence and other quantified
metrics. We transform sensor data into intuitive patient-facing mobile apps and intelligent AI/ML
dashboards for clinical professional and their care teams.

[Sensoria Smart Boot with embedded sensors for plantar‑pressure monitoring]

**Sensoria® Smart Boot™**

Diabetic Foot Ulcer patient mechanical offloading adherence and precise actigraphy monitoring for
better outcomes.

[Sensor‑enabled Smart Socks designed for capturing gait and mobility assessment data.]

**Smart Socks for Gait & Neurological Analysis and Assessments**

Wearable gait assessments producing digital biomarkers and RPM metrics across home and clinical
settings.

[Smart Plug designed to track power usage of intermittent cold compression therapy equipment.]

**Smart Plug for Intermittent Cold Compression Therapy (ICCT)**

Agentic, sensor-enabled ICCT that transforms home cold-compression therapy into a connected,
trackable experience.

[Sensor‑enabled knee brace designed to capture knee‑motion and rehabilitation data]

**Smart Knee Brace for Rehabilitation Monitoring**

Remote monitoring knee brace that measures Range of Motion (ROM) quality and exercise volume
throughout your rehabilitation journey.

CardioDay^{®} Holter EKG: Gewissheit bei der Long-QT-Syndrom-Diagnose und Therapie
Das Long-QT-Syndrom kann lebensbedrohliche Herzrhythmusstörungen verursachen. Langzeit-EKG-Aufnahmen
durch Holter ermöglichen die Messung des QT-Intervalls über 24 Stunden und führen dadurch zu einer
höheren Sensitivität und Spezifität. Mit dem CardioDay Holter EKG können auch große Datenmengen
genau und zuverlässig verarbeitet und voranalysiert werden.

Our technology is a safeguard against human errors, guaranteeing precise and unwavering vital sign monitoring, providing hospitals with a higher level of accuracy Real-time monitoring and proactive care result in higher patient satisfaction and confidence in your healthcare services Streamlined data collection and analysis boost productivity, enabling healthcare providers to serve more patients effectively ### Our Solutions [][8] Clinical Trials [][9] Home Monitoring ### Our Clients and Partners **OUR OFFICE:** Suit #600,1250 Rue Guy, Montréal, Quebec, H3H 2L3 145 Grandpark Cir, Ottawa Ontario, K1G 6R6 **Phone:** Canada: +1 (613) 276- 1413 We use cookies to ensure that we give you the best experience on our website.
